# Megan — Intuitive · Healer · Guide

> Megan is an intuitive reader, energy healer and spiritual guide offering sessions online worldwide, and in person at her next SoulSearch Enlightenment Expo in the San Francisco Bay Area. Her approach is grounded and thoughtful — clear messages from Spirit delivered without fear or theatrics. Feet on the earth, eyes on the stars.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://groundedwings.com/): Overview of Megan's intuitive, healing and guidance work.
- [About Megan](https://groundedwings.com/about/): Her story, approach, and what she will and won't do.
- [Sessions](https://groundedwings.com/sessions/): All session types and how they work.
- [Contact & Booking](https://groundedwings.com/contact/): Book a session online or in person.

## Sessions
- [Intuitive & Spirit Guide Readings](https://groundedwings.com/sessions/intuitive-readings/): Loving messages and clear guidance from angels and spirit guides.
- [Cord-Cutting Sessions](https://groundedwings.com/sessions/cord-cutting/): Release energetic attachments and patterns that no longer serve you.
- [Energy Healing](https://groundedwings.com/sessions/energy-healing/): Restore balance and raise your vibration; available as distance healing.
- [Expanded Consciousness & Multidimensional Insight](https://groundedwings.com/sessions/expanded-consciousness/): A grounded, thoughtful approach to higher perspectives, universal wisdom and multidimensional connection.
